name: Product QA For Woocommerce
author: Vishal Kakadiya

sections.description:
Product QA for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce addon that allows customers to ask questions directly on your product pages and get live answers. It supports full user interaction to give live answers on your WooCommerce store. Admin can add/edit/delete/approve all questions and answers with Product QA for WooCommerce.

This Product QA for WooCommerce plugin helps you build trust with your customers by allowing them to interact with your store before making a purchase decision. It is easy to manage for beginners to website developers.

Extra

You can open an issue and send PR on github repo at https://github.com/vishalkakadiya/product-qa-for-woocommerce
Have Fun! and Thanks
sections.installation:
1. Upload this plugin folder(including all files) to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go To Woocommerce -> Settings -> Products -> Product QA
  4. For more details check Screenshots.
  5. Thanks.
